lines: At the last moment, Pharaoh said: I believe. Allah's answer is still in the Quran.
When drowning overtook him, he said: I believe that there is no deity except the One in whom the Children of Israel believe.
Now? And you had disobeyed before, and were of the corrupters?
So today We will save you in body, that you may be a sign to those who come after you.
Don't wait for the last moment to turn to Allah. Turn today.
Watch the full movie of Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam... link below.

beats.text: At the last moment, Pharaoh said: *“I believe.”*

beats.ur: آخری لمحے فرعون نے کہا: میں ایمان لایا

beats.ur: آخری لمحے کا انتظار نہ کریں۔ آج اللہ کی طرف رجوع کریں

beats.text: Watch the full movie of *Prophet Musa (AS)*, link below.
beats.ur: حضرت موسیٰ علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Ancient Egypt and the Red Sea, long ago. Absolutely no prophet shown.

scenes.s1: The parted sea closing back with huge crashing waves under a stormy dawn sky, chariots' wheels and spears tumbling in the water, dramatic. No faces.
scenes.s2: Dark churning sea waves at dawn with a broken golden crown floating on the surface, dramatic light breaking through clouds. No people.
scenes.s3: An empty golden throne in a dim Egyptian palace hall with tall columns and hieroglyphs, dust in a beam of light, abandoned. No people.
scenes.s4: An empty ancient sea shore at dawn, gentle waves washing over wet sand where the sea has calmed after a storm, broken spears half buried. No people, no bodies.
scenes.s5: Bright calm sea at sunrise with gentle waves on a sandy shore, birds flying, hopeful golden light. No people.
